opening.argument: The video presents an easy passive-income opportunity built around deploying a contract and funding it with Ether. It instructs viewers, “So now we will deploy this to our wallet,” and links that funding to the ability “to snipe liquidity.” The described method uses a higher gas fee to process a transaction first, then sends a sell order within the same block, while claiming profit from sandwiching another user's transaction. It reinforces that pitch with a reported result of “around 1.17 Ether, which is around 17%.” Although it acknowledges that profitability varies, the available record does not independently establish that the software works, that the returns occurred as described, or that these transactions were safe.

citations.quote: In this YouTube video tutorial I'll be explaining to you an easy method to make passive income.
So now we will deploy this to our wallet.
the next step is to fund our contract with some Ethers to be able to snipe liquidity
the victim's transaction gets sandwiched between ours and we make a profit. From the slippage difference in the transaction.
So I have something around 1.17 Ether, which is around 17%.
